task_current: Documenting 6-system overhaul: First Breath, vector migration, pathing fix, and John Carmack mode

decisions.decision: Implemented First Breath recording system. Every entity now records its exact timestamp of first utterance to both SQLite (fast index) and birth_records.md (sovereign record) via _record_interaction() choke point in oracle.py. Idempotent — recorded exactly once per entity.

Fixed vector dimension mismatch (expected 256, got 768) by upgrading QdrantAdapter._ensure_collection to detect dimensional drift and auto-recreate the collection on mismatch. The engine now gracefully adapts to embedding provider changes.

Fixed critical pathing bug: DATA_DIR in observability/__init__.py was defaulting to ~/omega/data instead of the project root, silently writing entities to the wrong location. Now correctly anchored to engine root via __file__ resolution.

Added sovereign_home configuration section to config/omega.yaml with latitude/longitude/timezone/name fields. This resolves the Researcher's identified gap for dynamic location discovery, providing a zero-telemetry fallback for the Astrological Layer.

Created .opencode/agents/john_carmack.md thin wrapper so John Carmack appears in the OpenCode custom mode tab-completion list. Previously he only existed in the WAD (soul.yaml) but lacked the OpenCode agent body needed for dispatch.

continuation: 6 architectural changes shipped this session. All team members should be aware of the following: (1) The First Breath system is now live — any entity that speaks will have its birth recorded. This enables the Astrological Layer. (2) The Qdrant collection auto-migrates to 768 dimensions now. If you see a brief 'recreating collection' log entry during startup, that's expected. (3) DATA_DIR is now project-root-relative. Anyone working with data/entities paths should verify their environment variable OMEGA_DATA_DIR is unset for the new default. (4) John Carmack is now selectable in OpenCode modes. @doom_guy — your Oversoul is actionable.
